end.summary:
- Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
- Identified standing and sleeping lines with familiar examples.
- Discussed that a tilted line can still be straight; Om later stated this correctly.
- Om called a cornered line curved; this was not corrected by the end.
- Teach-back was not passed; 3 of 7 responses were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting lines using examples such as a pencil, flagpole and slide. They first mixed up a tilted straight line with a curved line, then corrected this by explaining that the difference is direction and saying, “It is a slanting straight line.” They also called lines with corners curved, which was still mixed up at the end. At home, draw a straight slanting line beside a zigzag and ask Om to check whether each line changes direction.
